metadata.title: Event Labels
metadata.author: generated from an FTL event wiki
metadata.description:
Prints the name of each event above its text, so you always know which encounter you are looking at. 386 events are labelled.
Text only - no choice, requirement, reward, ship or probability is changed.
Compatibility: - Built against FTL 1.6.x data. - 351 events are relabelled by replacing a string only that event uses, which leaves every event definition untouched. - 35 events are redefined outright, and will clobber another mod that redefines the same event (or be clobbered by it, depending on patch order).
